panelString: Your mission is to guide incoming planes to a safe landing. Planes will appear at the top of the screen and need to land on the matching colored runway.
Hold and drag to draw a flight path for each plane. Avoid collisions by planning safe routes.
Guide planes to their designated runway. Planes land automatically when they reach the correct runway.
Manage your time efficiently. Land planes as quickly as possible to earn more points.
